purpose: Define canonical relations as first-class explicit semantic identities connecting exact endpoint identities with declared role, direction and semantics rather than inferred adjacency.

value.identity_rule: Every machine-significant relation has an explicit stable identity.
value.endpoint_rule: Source and target endpoints resolve by exact canonical identity.
value.role_rule: Endpoint roles/names are explicit where machine-significant.
value.type_rule: Relation kind/semantics are explicit and separate from containment, ownership, authority and dependency unless the relation specifically represents one of those dimensions.
value.instance_rule: Relation definition and individual relation instance/use are distinguishable where needed.
value.no_inference_rule: Shared Topic, same schema, UI adjacency or naming similarity never creates a relation.
